body.name: Omega
body.type: finite set of legal joint choices
body.def: The legal Algorithm-2 assignments \(\omega=((r_g,c_g))_{g=1}^{k}\) with \(r_g\in R_g\) and \(c_g\in K_g\), including every acyclicity, pivot, canonicality, and label constraint; each label in \(V_{\mathrm{fix}}(\mathcal G,\ell)\) remains a fixed singleton mleaf.
